```ts
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import Stripe from 'stripe'
import { getStripe } from './client'
import { idempotencyKeyFor, withIdempotencyKey } from './idempotency'
import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
import {
  RPC,
  cents,
  type CentsAmount,
  type Currency,
  type StripeInvoiceRecordArgs,
} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'

export interface CreateSessionInvoiceArgs {
  studioId: string
  bookingId: string
  projectId: string
  sessionId: string
  artistId: string
  clientId: string
  customerId: string
  paymentMethodId: string
  currency: Currency
  baseAmountCents: CentsAmount
  tipAmountCents: CentsAmount
  depositDrawdownCents: CentsAmount
  applicationFeeCents: CentsAmount
  destinationAccount: string
}

export interface CreateSessionInvoiceResult {
  invoiceId: string
  paymentIntentId: string | null
  paymentIntentClientSecret: string | null
  paymentIntentStatus: Stripe.PaymentIntent.Status | null
  taxAmountCents: CentsAmount
  totalCents: CentsAmount
}

export async function createSessionInvoice(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  args: CreateSessionInvoiceArgs,
): Promise<CreateSessionInvoiceResult> {
  const stripe = getStripe()
  const idemKey = idempotencyKeyFor('invoice.create', {
    booking_id: args.bookingId,
    session_id: args.sessionId,
  })

  const invoice = await withIdempotencyKey(idemKey, (key) =>
    stripe.invoices.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        currency: args.currency,
        collection_method: 'charge_automatically',
        default_payment_method: args.paymentMethodId,
        application_fee_amount: args.applicationFeeCents,
        transfer_data: { destination: args.destinationAccount },
        on_behalf_of: args.destinationAccount,
        automatic_tax: { enabled: true },
        metadata: {
          inkos_idempotency_key: key,
          inkos_studio_id: args.studioId,
          inkos_booking_id: args.bookingId,
          inkos_project_id: args.projectId,
          inkos_session_id: args.sessionId,
          inkos_artist_id: args.artistId,
          inkos_client_id: args.clientId,
          inkos_deposit_drawdown_cents: String(args.depositDrawdownCents),
        },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: key },
    ),
  )

  await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
    {
      customer: args.customerId,
      invoice: invoice.id,
      currency: args.currency,
      amount: args.baseAmountCents,
      description: 'Tattoo session base',
      metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'base' },
    },
    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:base` },
  )

  if (args.tipAmountCents > 0) {
    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        invoice: invoice.id,
        currency: args.currency,
        amount: args.tipAmountCents,
        description: 'Tip',
        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'tip' },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:tip` },
    )
  }

  if (args.depositDrawdownCents > 0) {
    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        invoice: invoice.id,
        currency: args.currency,
        amount: -args.depositDrawdownCents,
        description: 'Deposit applied',
        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'deposit_drawdown' },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:drawdown` },
    )
  }

  await stripe.invoices.finalizeInvoice(
    invoice.id,
    { auto_advance: true },
    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:finalize` },
  )

  let paid: Stripe.Invoice
  try {
    paid = await stripe.invoices.pay(
      invoice.id,
      { payment_method: args.paymentMethodId, off_session: true },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:pay` },
    )
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error({ invoice_id: invoice.id, err }, 'S19 invoice pay failed')
    throw err
  }

  const recordArgs: StripeInvoiceRecordArgs = {
    studioId: args.studioId,
    invoiceId: paid.id,
    customerId: args.customerId,
    status: paid.status as 'paid' | 'open' | 'draft' | 'uncollectible' | 'void',
    currency: args.currency,
    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
    subtotalCents: cents(paid.subtotal ?? 0),
    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
    amountPaidCents: cents(paid.amount_paid ?? 0),
    amountDueCents: cents(paid.amount_due ?? 0),
    bookingId: args.bookingId,
    projectId: args.projectId,
    sessionId: args.sessionId,
    clientId: args.clientId,
    automaticTaxStatus:
      (paid.automatic_tax?.status ?? null) as
        | 'requires_location_inputs'
        | 'failed'
        | 'complete'
        | null,
    idempotencyKey: idemKey,
  }

  const { error: recordErr } = await supabase.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_INVOICE_RECORD, {
    p_studio_id: recordArgs.studioId,
    p_invoice_id: recordArgs.invoiceId,
    p_customer_id: recordArgs.customerId,
    p_status: recordArgs.status,
    p_currency: recordArgs.currency,
    p_total_cents: recordArgs.totalCents,
    p_subtotal_cents: recordArgs.subtotalCents,
    p_tax_amount_cents: recordArgs.taxAmountCents,
    p_amount_paid_cents: recordArgs.amountPaidCents,
    p_amount_due_cents: recordArgs.amountDueCents,
    p_booking_id: recordArgs.bookingId,
    p_project_id: recordArgs.projectId,
    p_session_id: recordArgs.sessionId,
    p_client_id: recordArgs.clientId,
    p_automatic_tax_status: recordArgs.automaticTaxStatus,
    p_idempotency_key: recordArgs.idempotencyKey,
  })

  if (recordErr) {
    logger.error(
      { invoice_id: paid.id, err: recordErr },
      'CRITICAL: stripe_invoice_record failed after invoice paid — rethrowing for retry',
    )
    throw recordErr
  }

  const piId =
    typeof paid.payment_intent === 'string'
      ? paid.payment_intent
      : (paid.payment_intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent | null)?.id ?? null

  return {
    invoiceId: paid.id,
    paymentIntentId: piId,
    paymentIntentClientSecret: null,
    paymentIntentStatus:
      typeof paid.payment_intent === 'object' && paid.payment_intent
        ? (paid.payment_intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent).status
        : null,
    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
  }
}
```

```ts
interface StripeInvoiceShape {
  id: string
  status: string
  total: number
  subtotal: number
  tax: number | null
  amount_paid: number
  amount_due: number
  payment_intent: string | { id: string } | null
  customer: string
  currency: string
  automatic_tax?: { status?: string | null } | null
  metadata?: Record<string, string | undefined> | null
  status_transitions?: { finalized_at?: number | null; paid_at?: number | null } | null
}

async function handleInvoiceFinalized(
  invoice: StripeInvoiceShape,
  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
): Promise<void> {
  const piId =
    typeof invoice.payment_intent === 'string'
      ? invoice.payment_intent
      : invoice.payment_intent?.id ?? null
  const finalizedAt = invoice.status_transitions?.finalized_at
    ? new Date(invoice.status_transitions.finalized_at * 1000).toISOString()
    : null

  const { error } = await supabase.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_INVOICE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
    p_invoice_id: invoice.id,
    p_status: invoice.status,
    p_payment_intent_id: piId,
    p_amount_paid_cents: invoice.amount_paid,
    p_finalized_at: finalizedAt,
    p_paid_at: null,
  })
  if (error) {
    logger.error(
      { invoice_id: invoice.id, err: error },
      'invoice.finalized webhook update failed',
    )
    throw error
  }
}

async function handleInvoicePaymentSucceeded(
  invoice: StripeInvoiceShape,
  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
): Promise<void> {
  const piId =
    typeof invoice.payment_intent === 'string'
      ? invoice.payment_intent
      : invoice.payment_intent?.id ?? null
  const paidAt = invoice.status_transitions?.paid_at
    ? new Date(invoice.status_transitions.paid_at * 1000).toISOString()
    : null

  const { error } = await supabase.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_INVOICE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
    p_invoice_id: invoice.id,
    p_status: 'paid',
    p_payment_intent_id: piId,
    p_amount_paid_cents: invoice.amount_paid,
    p_finalized_at: null,
    p_paid_at: paidAt,
  })
  if (error) {
    logger.error(
      { invoice_id: invoice.id, err: error },
      'invoice.payment_succeeded webhook update failed',
    )
    throw error
  }
}
```

427	    session_id: args.sessionId,
428	    payment_intent_id: pi.id,
429	    idempotency_key: piIdemKey,

441	  }

142	 * @param supabase - Service-role client. Bypasses RLS. Caller must supply this.

146	  event: StripeEventLike,
147	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
148	): Promise<void> {
149	  logger.info({ type: event.type, eventId: event.id }, 'stripe: processing event')
150	
151	  switch (event.type) {
152	    case 'account.updated':
153	      await handleAccountUpdated(event.data.object as StripeAccountShape, supabase)
154	      break
155	
156	    case 'payment_intent.succeeded':
157	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
158	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
159	        'succeeded',
160	        event.type,
161	        supabase,
162	      )
163	      break
164	
165	    case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
166	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
167	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
168	        'requires_payment_method',
169	        event.type,
170	        supabase,
171	      )
172	      break

174	    case 'payment_intent.canceled':

176	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
177	        'canceled',
178	        event.type,

183	    case 'charge.refunded': {

192	    case 'charge.dispute.closed':

194	      break

196	    default:

198	  }
199	}

252	function deriveOnboardingStatus(account: StripeAccountShape): ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus {
253	  if (account.charges_enabled && account.payouts_enabled) return 'active'
254	
255	  const disabledReason = account.requirements?.disabled_reason
256	  if (disabledReason) return 'restricted'
257	
258	  const errors = account.requirements?.errors ?? []
259	  if (errors.length > 0) return 'restricted'
260	
261	  return 'pending'
262	}

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import Stripe from 'stripe'
import { getStripe } from './client'
import { idempotencyKeyFor, withIdempotencyKey } from './idempotency'
import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
import {
  RPC,
  cents,
  type CentsAmount,
  type Currency,
  type StripeInvoiceRecordArgs,
} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'

export interface CreateSessionInvoiceArgs {
  studioId: string
  bookingId: string
  projectId: string
  sessionId: string
  artistId: string
  clientId: string
  customerId: string
  paymentMethodId: string
  currency: Currency
  baseAmountCents: CentsAmount
  tipAmountCents: CentsAmount
  depositDrawdownCents: CentsAmount
  applicationFeeCents: CentsAmount
  destinationAccount: string
}

export interface CreateSessionInvoiceResult {
  invoiceId: string
  paymentIntentId: string | null
  paymentIntentClientSecret: string | null
  paymentIntentStatus: Stripe.PaymentIntent.Status | null
  taxAmountCents: CentsAmount
  totalCents: CentsAmount
}

export async function createSessionInvoice(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  args: CreateSessionInvoiceArgs,
): Promise<CreateSessionInvoiceResult> {
  const stripe = getStripe()
  const idemKey = idempotencyKeyFor('invoice.create', {
    booking_id: args.bookingId,
    session_id: args.sessionId,
  })

  const invoice = await withIdempotencyKey(idemKey, (key) =>
    stripe.invoices.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        currency: args.currency,
        collection_method: 'charge_automatically',
        default_payment_method: args.paymentMethodId,
        application_fee_amount: args.applicationFeeCents,
        transfer_data: { destination: args.destinationAccount },
        on_behalf_of: args.destinationAccount,
        automatic_tax: { enabled: true },
        metadata: {
          inkos_idempotency_key: key,
          inkos_studio_id: args.studioId,
          inkos_booking_id: args.bookingId,
          inkos_project_id: args.projectId,
          inkos_session_id: args.sessionId,
          inkos_artist_id: args.artistId,
          inkos_client_id: args.clientId,
          inkos_deposit_drawdown_cents: String(args.depositDrawdownCents),
        },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: key },
    ),
  )

  await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
    {
      customer: args.customerId,
      invoice: invoice.id,
      currency: args.currency,
      amount: args.baseAmountCents,
      description: 'Tattoo session base',
      metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'base' },
    },
    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:base` },
  )

  if (args.tipAmountCents > 0) {
    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        invoice: invoice.id,
        currency: args.currency,
        amount: args.tipAmountCents,
        description: 'Tip',
        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'tip' },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:tip` },
    )
  }

  if (args.depositDrawdownCents > 0) {
    await stripe.invoiceItems.create(
      {
        customer: args.customerId,
        invoice: invoice.id,
        currency: args.currency,
        amount: -args.depositDrawdownCents,
        description: 'Deposit applied',
        metadata: { inkos_line_kind: 'deposit_drawdown' },
      },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:drawdown` },
    )
  }

  await stripe.invoices.finalizeInvoice(
    invoice.id,
    { auto_advance: true },
    { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:finalize` },
  )

  let paid: Stripe.Invoice
  try {
    paid = await stripe.invoices.pay(
      invoice.id,
      { payment_method: args.paymentMethodId, off_session: true },
      { idempotencyKey: `${idemKey}:pay` },
    )
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error({ invoice_id: invoice.id, err }, 'S19 invoice pay failed')
    throw err
  }

  const recordArgs: StripeInvoiceRecordArgs = {
    studioId: args.studioId,
    invoiceId: paid.id,
    customerId: args.customerId,
    status: paid.status as 'paid' | 'open' | 'draft' | 'uncollectible' | 'void',
    currency: args.currency,
    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
    subtotalCents: cents(paid.subtotal ?? 0),
    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
    amountPaidCents: cents(paid.amount_paid ?? 0),
    amountDueCents: cents(paid.amount_due ?? 0),
    bookingId: args.bookingId,
    projectId: args.projectId,
    sessionId: args.sessionId,
    clientId: args.clientId,
    automaticTaxStatus:
      (paid.automatic_tax?.status ?? null) as
        | 'requires_location_inputs'
        | 'failed'
        | 'complete'
        | null,
    idempotencyKey: idemKey,
  }

  const { error: recordErr } = await supabase.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_INVOICE_RECORD, {
    p_studio_id: recordArgs.studioId,
    p_invoice_id: recordArgs.invoiceId,
    p_customer_id: recordArgs.customerId,
    p_status: recordArgs.status,
    p_currency: recordArgs.currency,
    p_total_cents: recordArgs.totalCents,
    p_subtotal_cents: recordArgs.subtotalCents,
    p_tax_amount_cents: recordArgs.taxAmountCents,
    p_amount_paid_cents: recordArgs.amountPaidCents,
    p_amount_due_cents: recordArgs.amountDueCents,
    p_booking_id: recordArgs.bookingId,
    p_project_id: recordArgs.projectId,
    p_session_id: recordArgs.sessionId,
    p_client_id: recordArgs.clientId,
    p_automatic_tax_status: recordArgs.automaticTaxStatus,
    p_idempotency_key: recordArgs.idempotencyKey,
  })

  if (recordErr) {
    logger.error(
      { invoice_id: paid.id, err: recordErr },
      'CRITICAL: stripe_invoice_record failed after invoice paid — rethrowing for retry',
    )
    throw recordErr
  }

  const piId =
    typeof paid.payment_intent === 'string'
      ? paid.payment_intent
      : (paid.payment_intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent | null)?.id ?? null

  return {
    invoiceId: paid.id,
    paymentIntentId: piId,
    paymentIntentClientSecret: null,
    paymentIntentStatus:
      typeof paid.payment_intent === 'object' && paid.payment_intent
        ? (paid.payment_intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent).status
        : null,
    taxAmountCents: cents(paid.tax ?? 0),
    totalCents: cents(paid.total ?? 0),
  }
}
